title: Benefits and Harms of Large Language Models in Digital Mental Health

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative evaluation via literature review of the potential for LLMs to propagate racial stereotypes and systemic inequities in telehealth, such as the risk of over-diagnosing certain groups (e.g., Black patients with schizophrenia) based on skewed historical data.

Qualitative evaluation via literature review of the risk that LLMs will replicate human-like and systemic gender biases from training data, leading to unfair or inaccurate representations in patient-provider interactions.

Ecological framework analysis assessing the risks of LLMs lacking contextual and cultural understanding, potentially overlooking subtleties in mental health language related to the lived experiences of non-majority populations.
